 Navigation Toggle Nuggets play Raptors at home on Wednesday
 Matt Brooks ● @MattBrooksNBA Writer & Digital Content Specialist November 4, 2026 9:14 AM MST The Denver Nuggets face the Toronto Raptors in their second home game of the week.
 INJURY REPORT 
 Denver:
Alpha Diallo — PROBABLE (Right Wrist Sprain)
Cameron Johnson — PROBABLE (Lower Body Injury Management)
Spencer Jones — OUT (Bilateral Hamstring Injury Management)
Julian Strawther — OUT (Left Knee Sprain)
 Toronto:
Nate Bittle — OUT (Right Avulsion Fracture)
Kawhi Leonard — OUT (Left Knee Injury Management)
Jakob Poeltl — QUESTIONABLE (Left Shoulder Bursitis)
Malachi Smith — OUT (G League Two-Way Assignment)
 Denver heads into Wednesday with a 3-3 record. 
 They're coming off a 118-110 loss to the Portland Trail Blazers. That brought their record at Ball Arena to 1-2.
 Jamal Murray was the bright spot for the Nuggets on Monday. He finished with a gaudy scoring line—35 points on 10-of-19 shooting, 4-of-9 from distance, and 11-of-11 from the free-throw line. He's scored 42, 39, and 35 points in his first six outings.
 Toronto, meanwhile, sits at 4-3 on the year. They've been mostly without seven-time All-Star Kawhi Leonard (knee injury), who arrived in Toronto via an offseason trade. The Raptors boast the NBA's sixth-best offense and seventh-best defense.
 TUNE-IN : Wednesday, November 4, 7:00 p.m. MT; Altitude TV; Altitude+ ; Altitude Sports Radio 950 AM
